headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a thrilling 4-3 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. Justin Sterner (Athletics) was transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right knee chondromalacia. Tyler Soderstrom (Athletics) was placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 15, 2026, with left hip impingement. Masataka Yoshida (Boston Red Sox) was placed on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain. Justin Wrobleski (Los Angeles Dodgers) was placed on the 15-day injured list due to left forearm inflammation.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. Jonathan Ornelas was traded from the Athletics to the Milwaukee Brewers for cash. Harold Rivas was traded from the Boston Red Sox to the Baltimore Orioles as part of the 8/3 Adley Rutschman trade.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, led by a dominant performance from Michael McGreevy. McGreevy pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 6 batters while allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees suffered a 4-1 loss to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Charles McAdoo leading the Yankees' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Fall to Giants in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Colorado Rockies 7-1, handing them a tough loss. Drew Gilbert led the Rockies' offense with a 3-hit, 3-RBI performance, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Orioles Rout Rays 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Tampa Bay Rays in a lopsided 10-2 victory. Impact hitters for the Orioles included Jackson Holliday, Colton Cowser, Ryan Vilade, and Chandler Simpson.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Red Sox 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a decisive 8-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Connor Wong and Esmerlyn Valdez leading the way for the winning team. Bryan Reynolds also contributed to the Pirates' strong performance.

top_news.title: **Athletics RHP Justin Sterner Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Justin Sterner has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right knee chondromalacia diagnosis.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have strengthened their infield with the addition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash.
